component.name: Anatase Adblocker
component.summary: Blocks ads and trackers in Anatase Browser

description.p: Adblocker is the managed content blocker bundled for Anatase Browser. It is built from uBO Lite source and packaged as a Chromium extension for the browser Flatpak.
The extension ships with default filter lists and updates through the Anatase's repositories, so the filter lists can update more often.
If you are facing an issue with ads not being blocked, try updating the extension through Discover and restarting your browser. If that does not work, get in touch.
